output:
Nephi is the Book of Mormon writer who introduces himself as someone “born of goodly parents” and “highly favored of the Lord,” who made a record of his life and experiences. He states that he made plates “with mine own hands,” kept the records of his people, and wrote an account of his “reign and ministry.”

#### Sources

- [1 Nephi 1:1] — “*I, Nephi, having been born of goodly parents… having been highly favored of the Lord… therefore I make a record of my proceedings in my days.*”
- [1 Nephi 10:1] — “*And now I, Nephi, proceed to give an account upon these plates of my proceedings, and my reign and ministry…*”
- [1 Nephi 1:17] — “*Behold, I make an abridgment of the record of my father, upon plates which I have made with mine own hands… then will I make an account of mine own life.*”
- [2 Nephi 5:29] — “*And I, Nephi, had kept the records upon my plates, which I had made, of my people thus far.*”
- [2 Nephi 5:31] — “*Wherefore, I, Nephi, to be obedient to the commandments of the Lord, went and made these plates upon which I have engraven these things.*”
